answer: Proof of Stake requires agents to lock capital as collateral to validate transactions, reaching a zenith of security by tying network influence to asset ownership rather than ephemeral identities. Unlike systems where malicious actors wander freely between accounts to spoof nodes, this mechanism creates a financial nebula of high entry costs. An attacker must acquire a majority stake to compromise consensus, making the cost of Sybil creation prohibitively expensive and economically irrational.
